headline.text: L1 cleared *4 machine problems* but still waiting on hot water capacity and a labeler fix — L2 and L3 each have one active jam.

per_plant_summary.L1: Four equipment problems resolved inside the shift — corn syrup pump, demolder sensor, X-ray detection, and butter tank heating. Two remain open: dishwashing hot water capacity shortfall and a labeler in Sollich 2 awaiting vendor support.
per_plant_summary.L2: Both lines started clean. FFS had two brief stoppages for film and alignment, both cleared in minutes. ML2 cross conveyor is jamming every 20 minutes with no fault code — Dave Ruff investigating at window close.
per_plant_summary.L3: ML1 and ML4 both ran through the window. ML1 has a belt alignment flag at 13:07 waiting on maintenance. ML4 replaced a ripped sweco screen and cleared a foreign-material find during install.

resolved.title: X-ray test cards not detecting on Sollich 2
resolved.summary: System failed verification with test cards at 08:06; product already on line was held for re-inspection.
resolved.resolution: Troy performed corrective maintenance, passed 30 consecutive test-card runs, held product being re-inspected at 08:19.

resolved.title: Butter tank heating plate not working on Sollich 3
resolved.summary: Plate calling for hot water but not receiving it; system unable to heat butter reserve.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 12:29 — "Found that circuit breaker was tripped and had to be reset. Everything is heating up like it should now."

resolved.title: Corn syrup pump not working, filled manually
resolved.summary: Kitchen 2 pump failed overnight; missing gray roller on one side prevented automatic filling.
resolved.resolution: Troy replaced missing roller at 05:20 — "I have fixed this. the problem was that there wasn't a roller on the one side."

resolved.title: Demolder sensor fell out on Sollich 2
resolved.summary: Sensor dislodged before startup; Justin reinstalled and line was ready to run.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 05:06 — "Justin fixed and line is ready" (Jeffrey Barney).

resolved.title: Cap machine rejecting all jars on Sollich 2
resolved.summary: Lid applicator rejected every jar starting at 08:26; Troy and maintenance responded.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 08:51 — "The cap machine is no longer rejecting" (Victor Romero Sr.).

resolved.title: FFS line down for loose film roll
resolved.summary: Roll came loose; crew added a film frame to secure it.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 07:04 — "line is back up" (Alex Mendoza).

resolved.title: FFS line stopped to adjust white line alignment
resolved.summary: Registration adjustment needed during run; brief stoppage.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 11:01 — "Line is back up and running" (Jeffrey Barney).

resolved.title: North sweco screen ripped on ML4
resolved.summary: Screen failed during operation; replacement needed from spare inventory.
resolved.resolution: Replaced at 12:13 — "Screen done ✅ side north" (Mirella Mamani). Spare pulled from aisle 11-60E.

resolved.title: Foreign material found in ML4 sweco during install
resolved.summary: Cookie pieces discovered inside bagged and ATP-passed sweco screen at 13:01; FSQA and Kevin Del Valle called.
resolved.resolution: Cleared at 13:15 — Kevin inspected, confirmed cookie pieces, "the EE clean it and removed all the pieces before installing it."

needs_attention.title: Butter system found off, butter and coconut hose frozen in Kitchen 1
needs_attention.summary: System was turned off overnight; butter in reserve tank solidified and coconut line also froze, delaying caramel cooking at startup.
needs_attention.status: Reported at 05:40 with photos; no follow-up resolution posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: Labeler Area A producing wrinkled labels on Sollich 2
needs_attention.summary: Labels coming out wrinkled; Chris Jeffs working on machine, Troy submitted service request to All Fill vendor.
needs_attention.status: Service request submitted at 12:32, awaiting vendor response as of window close.

needs_attention.title: No hot water in dishwashing area 2
needs_attention.summary: Dishwashing station not receiving hot water; investigation found plant pulling too much hot water across all lines, insufficient capacity for wash area.
needs_attention.status: Root cause identified at 11:56 — boiler pressure check shows demand exceeds supply. No fix posted by window close.

needs_attention.title: ML2 cross conveyor belt stopping intermittently, no fault code
needs_attention.summary: Belt stops every 20 minutes causing chocolate bars to pile up; HMI shows gray (no fault), ramp conveyor stays down.
needs_attention.status: Dave Ruff on-site monitoring as of 11:54, unsure why belt stops without fault. Line running but issue recurring.

needs_attention.title: Belt C6 shifted, alarm triggered on ML1 flow-wrap
needs_attention.summary: Conveyor belt misaligned, triggering monitoring alarm; maintenance adjustment required.
needs_attention.status: Alarm triggered at 13:07, maintenance called. No follow-up posted by window close.
